verdict.rationale: OpenAI's own SDKs, CLI, and HTTP client are documented as the native way to access the platform (gpt-docs-3, gpt-docs-25, gpt-gh-1), and since OpenAI defines the API schema, OpenAI-compatible tooling trivially targets it. However, the evidence only shows an internal migration guide from Chat Completions to the Responses API (gpt-docs-15), not a documented adapter/migration path from other providers' SDKs (e.g., Anthropic, Cohere) onto OpenAI's platform. Missing for 10: explicit third-party-to-OpenAI migration/adapter documentation, and any compatibility-shim guidance for non-OpenAI SDKs.
